provenance.processing: LRO LOLA LDEM_80S_40M, 256 by 256 pixel crop at the region centre, 40 m per pixel, elevation in metres relative to the 1,737.4 km reference sphere. Polar stereographic grid (not north-up). Pixels outside the region outline filled from nearest valid pixel.

stats.method: Central finite differences (numpy.gradient) at 40 m spacing, slope = atan(|grad|) in degrees; histogram has 45 bins of 1 deg from 0 to 45 (steeper pixels counted in the last bin), values are fractions summing to 1. Relief = 95th minus 5th percentile of elevation. Same code for Earth and Moon.
